rationale: Directly tested route definition: /api/stock-outs does not exist. Any inventory write-off attempt from the UI produces a 404 failure.
remediation: Update inventory.ejs to post to /stock-out and add an alias in server.js.

rationale: 'chala' is standard Uzbek vocabulary for partial/incomplete products. Censoring it falsely blocks legitimate business entries.
Missing fallback defaults in updateStockIn/updateStockOut generate NaN calculations and Prisma validation crashes.
remediation: Default undefined quantity and price to existing record values.

rationale: Direct mismatch between logged module name ('stock') and UI filter ('stock_in', 'stock_out'). Stats always render 0.
remediation: Update audit-logs.ejs to check for module === 'stock' and action prefix, plus add translation mappings.

rationale: Serving HTML 404 pages on /api/* routes violates REST architecture and can confuse HTTP client parsers.
remediation: Add an API-specific 404 handler returning JSON for /api/* requests before rendering HTML 404.

rationale: Empirically confirmed: negative skip causes Prisma engine assertion failure and unhandled 500 crashes.
remediation: Enforce Math.max(1, parseInt(page) || 1) across all paginated controllers.

rationale: Cookie fallback exists in auth middleware but is dormant because login/logout doesn't set/clear cookies.
remediation: Set httpOnly accessToken cookie on login/refresh and clear on logout.

rationale: In-memory filtering of 20 pre-sliced items produces incomplete results and wrong pagination.
remediation: Support status filtering or pass active/stock query parameters properly.
